status: prospective_protocol; execution pending confirmed local cycle-boundary workflow
unit: completed operating cycle on one identified refrigerator; never an arbitrary request batch
boundary_capture: operator records actual compressor activation/deactivation, UTC-aware times, stable equipment/cycle IDs and evidence independently of model output; any automated detector requires separate validation before adoption
signal_policy: existing temperature/instantaneous vibration readings may be linked for audit; this candidate does not use them as predictors, and does not infer cycle boundaries from sparse timestamp gaps

ground_truth.target: observed functional maintenance reference; compressor-component diagnosis requires separate technical evidence

prospective_reservation: historical backup was explored earlier and is not a pristine prospective test; reserve new cycles after this protocol/model freeze

sampling.warmup_cycles: at least 3 before each reset; excluded from classified-case denominator, included in total coverage
sampling.availability: start with observed normal operation; absence of natural confirmed faults makes anomaly recall inconclusive

prototype_success.support: both classes and episode/session targets above; otherwise partial/inconclusive

probability_policy: evaluate experimental cohort-reference mapping with Brier/log loss and reliability only when reference support permits; raw 0.5 threshold remains frozen; no universal physical-failure probability claim
safe_observation: do not create a dangerous fault or damage equipment to complete positive support
audit_destination: study_external_cases, study_external_case_readings, study_external_ground_truth, study_external_predictions; case/model/truth versions explicit; private artifacts outside Git
tuning_policy: no fitting, calibration, alignment or threshold selection using this campaign; any revision consumes it as known evidence and requires a new independent reservation
metabase: out of scope; team members consume the database
